_dr_note: STRATELOQ DR n8n workflow manifest (Stage-2E, hardened). Credential values NEVER included — only references {id,name}. Full DR regeneration requires BOTH: (1) apply supabase migration mig_292_stage2_cj_search_idempotency.sql, (2) recreate this 14-node workflow per the structure below (claim gate + IF branch + webhook header auth). The sibling *.sdk.js is the INITIAL 9-node build only; the hardening (claim gate, complete, duplicate-replay, header auth, required request_id) was applied via workflow update ops + mig_292 and is described authoritatively here. The live n8n workflow is the source of truth.
name: Pulse — Stage-2 CJ Supplier Search (search-only)
deployment_note: Built, validated, fixture-tested, hardened. INACTIVE/unpublished by design — activation + a live auth probe is the founder-gated step (webhook auth rejection is only provable against a live endpoint).

trigger.auth_note: Reuses the shared inbound webhook credential used by existing Pulse webhook workers. Secret value lives only in the n8n credential store (never in repo/JSON/logs).

nodes.name: Stage-2 Search Request
nodes.role: runtime input + header auth (x-pulse-webhook-secret) enforced before any node

nodes.name: Validate Input
nodes.role: fail-closed validation; request_id REQUIRED (regex [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,200}); uuid tenant/product; non-empty market+search_query; persist default false

nodes.name: Claim Request
nodes.role: ATOMIC idempotency gate: rpc/fn_stage2_cj_search_claim (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)

nodes.name: IF Proceed
nodes.role: proceed==true -> CJ path (first claimer only); else -> duplicate replay (no CJ)

nodes.name: Get Retrieval Plan
nodes.role: rpc/fn_stage2_cj_retrieval_plan -> canonical English query set (mig_300/301) + budget (page_size 20, max_pages_per_query 5, max_candidates 200, max_api_calls 40)

nodes.name: Paginate CJ
nodes.role: bounded retrieval loop (mig_302): per query, page 1..max_pages_per_query via CJ product/list (this.helpers.httpRequest, CJ token from CJ Auth); per-page stop mirrors fn_stage2_cj_should_continue (error/rate-limit/last-page/max-pages/candidate-budget); accumulates page responses {query,page_num,http_status,body,attempts}; TEST-only __mock_cj injection bypasses live CJ. Builds rpc_body for Resolve From Pages. No match decision. RATE-LIMIT HARDENING (live-reval fix): CJ product/list is ~1 req/sec/token; the live path paces calls (PACE_MS=1300 default, between-call) and retries transient throttles once (RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=2600, MAX_ATTEMPTS=2) on thrown-request (http_status 0), HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, or a CJ body-level throttle (result=false + 'too many/frequent/QPS/exceed/interval/per second' message). Retries draw from the SAME api-call budget (max_api_calls=40) — the budget is NOT increased; mock path is untouched (no pacing/retry, attempts=0). Pacing/retry knobs are overridable from budget (pace_ms, retry_backoff_ms, max_attempts_per_page) without a node change.

nodes.name: Resolve From Pages
nodes.role: rpc/fn_stage2_resolve_from_pages -> dedup by CJ pid + finalize + fn_resolve_concrete_supplier_identity (unchanged); p_persist from input; returns verdict + retrieval_stats

nodes.name: Complete Request
nodes.role: rpc/fn_stage2_cj_search_complete: store result on the claimed row (enables duplicate replay)

nodes.name: Duplicate Replay Response
nodes.role: duplicate-path envelope (idempotent_replay=true) returning cached result; CJ never called

runtime_input_contract.request_id: REQUIRED idempotency key, regex [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,200}; fail closed if missing/malformed; never server-generated

idempotency.gate: fn_stage2_cj_search_claim — INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; only the winning INSERT returns proceed=true
idempotency.concurrency: two near-simultaneous identical claims: the unique index serializes; exactly one proceeds, the other gets duplicate=true (no CJ)
idempotency.duplicate_replay: returns the stored result (or in-progress status) without reaching CJ
idempotency.cross_tenant_or_product_or_market: isolated (distinct logical key; cross-tenant also fails closed via ownership check)

decision_contract.persistence: p_persist=false => evaluate only (no bind); p_persist=true => upsert on (tenant, product, market), bind only on EXACT

pagination_upgrade._note: DEPLOYED (active version aea579ae-edc2-411e-9eed-a33a5e3ffb16). The live workflow now fetches up to budget.max_pages_per_query pages per canonical query (was single page pageNum=1/pageSize=20), dedups by CJ pid, and resolves via fn_stage2_resolve_from_pages. The DB owns the pagination POLICY + candidate AGGREGATION (deterministic, self-tested: fn_stage2_cj_pagination_selftest 10/10); the Paginate CJ node performs the bounded HTTP loop (per-page stop mirrors fn_stage2_cj_should_continue) and feeds pages back. Verified end-to-end via mocked n8n execution (execution 30480: pages 1->2->3 fetched, partial-page stop, 429 error page recorded without aborting, Build Response EXACT) and re-verified after the rate-limit fix via mocked execution 30482 (error page recorded without aborting; deep-page match resolved; mock path makes 0 api calls / 0 sleeps).
pagination_upgrade._rate_limit_fix: LIVE REVALIDATION (execution 30481) exposed an internal execution defect: the Paginate CJ loop fired CJ product/list calls with NO inter-call delay, so CJ (~1 req/sec/token) THREW ~7 of 15 calls (http_status 0, empty body) — 'manger scene' got zero pages and five queries were cut short. The NO_VALID_CJ_MATCH verdict there reflected DEGRADED RECALL, not trustworthy absence. Fix (in-budget, no budget increase): pace live calls (PACE_MS=1300 between calls) and retry transient throttles once (RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=2600, MAX_ATTEMPTS=2) on thrown-request/429/5xx/body-throttle; retries count against the unchanged max_api_calls=40. Offline harness 10/10; mocked regression 30482 PASS.
pagination_upgrade._recall_allocation_fix: Post-pacing LIVE run (execution 30483) was throttle-free (10/10 pages HTTP 200) but exposed a SECOND recall defect: the two broadest queries ('nativity scene','nativity set') returned 5 full pages each and HIT the 200-candidate budget, so the 6 remaining queries — including the most on-target 'nativity scene wall decoration' / 'led nativity scene wall decoration' — NEVER ran; NO_VALID_CJ_MATCH there was still not trustworthy. Fix (in-budget, no budget increase): the Paginate CJ loop is now BREADTH-FIRST (round-robin) — it fetches page 1 of EVERY canonical query before any query goes deeper, so a broad query can no longer starve the distinguishing-attribute queries. This is budget ALLOCATION only: same page_size 20, max_pages_per_query 5, max_candidates 200, max_api_calls 40. Offline round-robin harness 12/12 (representation guarantee, per-query stop, retry, pacing, budget ceiling, mock path); mocked regression 30484 PASS (all 8 queries' page 1 examined, deep-query exact resolved, manger-scene error page recorded without aborting).

db_contract.per_page_stop: fn_stage2_cj_should_continue(page, page_num, collected, budget) -> { continue, reason, is_error, rate_limited, rows }
db_contract.aggregate: fn_stage2_cj_finalize_candidates(pages[], budget) -> { candidates[] (dedup by CJ pid, capped), stats }
db_contract.one_call_resolve: fn_stage2_resolve_from_pages(tenant, product, market, pages[], persist) -> resolver verdict + retrieval_stats

loop.queries: BREADTH-FIRST (round-robin) over plan.search.queries (canonical English expansion; mig_300/301): round r fetches page r of every still-active query, in order, so page 1 of ALL queries is examined before any query goes to page 2. This guarantees the distinguishing-attribute queries are examined within the fixed candidate budget (a broad query cannot starve them).
loop.per_query: pageNum tracks the round; pageSize = budget.page_size (20); live calls are paced (~1.3s between calls) to respect CJ's ~1 req/sec/token limit; a transient throttle (thrown http_status 0 / 429 / 5xx / body result=false throttle message) is retried once after a longer backoff before the page is recorded; after each page the per-page stop mirrors fn_stage2_cj_should_continue; a query is marked done on error-after-retry / partial (last) page / max_pages / candidate-budget and is not revisited in later rounds
stop_query_when: is_error AFTER retry (http>=400 / persistent 429 / 5xx / malformed page / thrown http_status 0)
loop.error_handling: live calls are paced and transient throttles retried once (in-budget) so a rate-limit does NOT masquerade as genuine absence; a page that still fails after retry stops ONLY that query and is recorded in stats.errors; other queries continue; the run never aborts on a single page error
loop.dedup: cross-page + cross-query dedup by CJ product id (pid), first occurrence wins (fn_stage2_cj_finalize_candidates)

with: Paginate CJ (loop: SplitInBatches over queries + inner page loop calling CJ product/list and rpc/fn_stage2_cj_should_continue; accumulate page responses {query,page_num,http_status,body})
Resolve From Pages (httpRequest -> rpc/fn_stage2_resolve_from_pages with the accumulated pages + persist)
